# EventCameraPoseInput

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of asynchronous event streams from neuromorphic vision sensors as direct input to the PnP algorithm, bypassing frame-based representations. Leverages the temporal sparsity and high dynamic range of event cameras, aligning with iNEST's goal of end-to-end neuromorphic perception pipelines.
